Simulation-based calibration of a lens (Stage-0 SS11; Talts et al. 2018)

Source: R/validation.R
sbc_check.Rd

Repeatedly draws true parameters from the prior, simulates a dataset from the lens's own generative model, fits the lens, and records the rank of each true parameter among the (thinned) posterior draws. If the lens samples its posterior correctly, the ranks are uniform on 0:n_keep; systematic departures (a chi-squared test per parameter) reveal a miscalibrated sampler.

Usage

sbc_check(
  generate,
  fit_fn,
  param_names,
  n_sims = 128L,
  n_keep = 64L,
  n_bins = 8L,
  alpha = 0.05,
  seed = 1L
)

Arguments

generate

A function (seed) -> list(theta = named-numeric, pass = koine_pass): draws true parameters from the prior and builds a pass whose data is simulated from the model at theta. theta's names must match the posterior draw variables to be ranked.

fit_fn

A function (pass) -> koine_fb_fit (the lens, with its sampler controls already set).

param_names

Character vector of parameters to rank (a subset of the names of theta and of the fit's draw variables).

n_sims

Number of SBC replications.

n_keep

Posterior draws retained per fit (the ranks lie in 0:n_keep); draws are thinned to this many to keep the rank statistic near-independent.

n_bins

Number of histogram bins for the chi-squared uniformity test.

alpha

Family-wise significance level (Bonferroni-adjusted across parameters) below which calibration is judged to have failed.

seed

Master seed; per-replication seeds are derived from it.

Value

A list with ranks (an n_sims x length(param_names) matrix), n_keep, uniformity (a data frame of param, chisq, df, p_value), alpha_adj, and passed (logical: every parameter's p-value exceeds the adjusted alpha).

Details

SBC validates the {prior, model, sampler} triple as a whole, so the generate callback must simulate data from exactly the model the lens assumes (e.g. a Student-t likelihood for the robust-t lens), using the exact prior the lens places.

Examples

# \donttest{
setup <- koine_lens_validation_setup(
  "dram", n_obs = 30L,
  fit_control = list(n_iter = 800L, n_burn = 400L, n_chains = 2L))
res <- sbc_check(setup$generate, setup$fit_fn, setup$param_names,
                 n_sims = 16L, n_keep = 16L, n_bins = 4L)
res$passed
#> [1] TRUE
# }
